generationInputs.prompt:
Vertical video 9:16, 8 seconds total, seamless loop, TikTok style, high contrast, clean composition.

Scene 1 (0–2s):
Close-up of a smartphone chat (dark mode).
Typing animation:
“¿Ya llegamos?”
Cursor blinking.
Overlay text large and bold:
“Siempre escribes esto…”

Scene 2 (2–5s):
Smooth pop transition.
The typed message transforms into a sticker:
Adorable chihuahua sticker with impatient expression.
Text inside sticker:
“¿Ya llegamos?”

Then quickly show 2 more stickers:
“Hambre”
“Jalo”

Each appears with soft bounce animation.

Scene 3 (5–8s):
Final frame:
Chihuahua sticker centered, looking at viewer.

Text:
“Siempre hay un sticker”

Then smoothly transition back to Scene 1:
Sticker fades into chat input field,
cursor appears again typing “¿Ya llegamos?”

IMPORTANT:
The ending must visually match the beginning for a perfect seamless loop.

Style:
Sticker aesthetic, bold outlines, expressive chihuahua, soft lighting, no pure white (use off-white tones), subtle shadow, minimal background.

Text must be large, bold, high contrast, Spanish language only.

No watermark, no clutter, clean UI.👉🏻👉🏻👉🏻👉🏻en una imagen de 3x3 haz el storyboard de ese prompt
